faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Himalayan?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 7-14 lb (3-6.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Himalayan?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Polycystic kidney disease (PKD) risk; Brachycephalic concerns; Dental disease. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Himalayan at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Himalayan default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
